fact: The final document of the ENDE 2018-2020 (national statistics development strategy) was validated at a workshop on 8-12 October 2018, following drafting steps from April 2018; no adoption is stated.
The first strategy, ENDE-1 (2015-2017), was evaluated from 27 November to 1 December 2017, finding an execution rate of 24.13%.
PARIS21's January 2026 NSDS status table lists the strategy as implementing (adopted): ENDE 2021-2024.
